resources.string:
QuickLock uses the Accessibility Service solely to lock your screen when you tap the persistent notification.

This service does NOT read, collect, or monitor any window content, text, or personal data on your screen. It only performs the system "Lock Screen" action when triggered by you.

You can disable this service at any time from Settings → Accessibility.
Persistent notification to lock the screen with a single tap.

Step 1 — Enable Accessibility Service

 Tap the button below to open Accessibility Settings.
 Find QuickLock in the list of installed services and enable it.
 Once enabled, a persistent notification will appear in your notification shade.
 Tap that notification at any time to instantly lock your screen.

Step 2 — Disable Battery Optimization (Huawei / EMUI)

 Huawei's aggressive battery management can kill QuickLock in the background.
 To prevent this:

 Option A — Via the button below:
 Tap "Open Battery Optimization Settings", find QuickLock, and set it to Don't optimize (or Allow).

 Option B — Via EMUI Battery Settings:
 1. Go to Settings → Battery → App launch.
 2. Find QuickLock and toggle OFF "Manage automatically".
 3. In the dialog, enable Run in background and Auto-launch.
 4. Tap OK to confirm.

 This ensures QuickLock's notification stays active even after prolonged idle time.
